questions.passage: A hospital pharmacy dispensed 8,400 items in January. In February, dispensing increased by 12%. In March, it decreased by 8% from February.
questions.question: How many items were dispensed in March? (Round to nearest whole number)

questions.passage: A patient requires a saline drip at 1.5 mL/kg/hr. The patient weighs 60 kg. Normal saline bags are 1,000 mL.
questions.question: How long will one 1,000 mL bag last? (Round down to nearest whole hour)
questions.explanation: Rate = 60 × 1.5 = 90 mL/hr. Time = 1,000 ÷ 90 = 11.11 hours. Round down to 11 hours.

questions.passage: A hospital has 120 medical staff in the ratio of consultants:registrars:junior doctors = 2:5:3.
questions.question: How many registrars are there?

questions.passage: A renal unit performs haemodialysis sessions of 4 hours each. The unit has 10 dialysis machines and operates 6 days per week. Each machine can run 2 sessions per day.
questions.question: How many dialysis sessions can the unit perform per week?
questions.explanation: Sessions per machine per day = 2. Total per day = 10 × 2 = 20. Per week = 20 × 6 = 120.

questions.passage: A clinical trial enrolled 400 patients. 200 received the active drug, 200 received placebo. In the drug group, 150 completed the trial. In the placebo group, 170 completed.
questions.question: What was the overall completion rate across both groups?

questions.passage: A child weighing 12 kg requires salbutamol nebuliser at 2.5 mg. Salbutamol solution comes as 5 mg in 2.5 mL.
questions.question: How many mL of salbutamol solution should be drawn up for one nebulisation?
questions.explanation: Required = 2.5 mg. Concentration = 5 mg per 2.5 mL = 2 mg/mL. Volume = 2.5 ÷ 2 = 1.25 mL.

questions.passage: A surgical list has 5 cases scheduled. The average case takes 40 minutes, with 10 minutes between cases for cleaning. The list starts at 08:00.
questions.question: At what time is the list expected to finish?
questions.explanation: 5 cases × 40 min = 200 min. 4 gaps × 10 min = 40 min. Total = 200 + 40 = 240 min = 4 hours. 08:00 + 4:00 = 12:00.
